[[File:Patrick Johnson 2026 US Nationals.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Patrick Johnson at the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]].]]
'''Patrick Johnson''' (also '''Pat Johnson''', GEMP '''Pmj'''; also listed as '''PMJ''') won the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] and finished '''#17''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]]. <ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
